comments.author: DeadLeaves
comments.body_html:
Yeah, those are old things that are no longer supported. I should update the description page I suppose. To get the same barters every time, set the following setting to true (its near the bottom)

“saveloadBarters”: true

Do keep in mind that if you add new trades to traders later (mods that add new items etc) they will be overridden by that setting. If you do, you need to delete all files in the _savedbarters folder so it generates new barters
